sentences.en: With restrictions removed, thousands of new enterprises have come into being.
sentences.zh: 解除限制后，成千上万的新企业应运而生。

sentences.en: Critics are coming down hard on tightened economic restrictions.
sentences.zh: 批评人士对收紧的经济限制措施给予了严厉批评。

sentences.en: Import restrictions are barriers to closer relations between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 进口限制是两国关系更加密切的障碍。

senses.zh: 限制，约束；限制条件，限制规定；受限制的事物
